messages:
cora (AE): AxonFin wants to start a 30-day pilot but is requesting a temporary VPC peering exception and an executive signoff to proceed without peering for throughput reasons. They're asking for a hard spend cap and liability language. Need triage.

devon (Sales Eng): They say the ETL still needs peering for peak throughput, but will accept a stopgap. Do we have a standard playbook for short-term exceptions?

aj (Solutions Eng): From the network diagram they shared: peering is preferred. Ops can stand up a NAT with strict ACLs within ~24h, but it's not identical to peering for perf. Alternative: NAT + mTLS + token-level masking + autoscale throttles.

cora (AE): Ledger of asks: 30 days, single dev tenant, up to 8M tokens, $12k cap. They will redact PII before ingesting. They explicitly requested CRO-level signoff to avoid schedule slip.

mia (Security): Quick note: if we move forward without peering we require TLS1.3, per-connection mTLS, auditable access lists, and token-level masking for PII. I can draft the security addendum and the minimum runtime config.

lisa (Legal): I'll need exact pilot boundaries and a statement of accepted risk. Provide the spend cap and who signs indemnity. I can prepare a one-off addendum labeled: "Pilot network exception — limited liability, 30-day, capped spend."

nate (CRO): I'm willing to provide provisional exec ack so long as legal and security produce artifacts and the pilot is auto-stoppable on any PII discovery. @lisa @mia need those deliverables.

devon (Sales Eng): Ops requested a runbook snippet to implement the hard throttle when cap hits. Drafting a simple autoscaler trigger.

aj (Solutions Eng): Runbook pseudo:
```bash
# autoscaler/alert pseudo-command
if (billing.usage.tokens > 8000000 || billing.amount > 12000) then
  block_new_requests --scope=pilot-axonfin
  alert --to=cora,lisa,mia,nate
fi
```

support-bot: created ticket #4621 (axonfin-pilot-network-exception). Assigned: eng-infra, security, legal.

cora (AE): Next steps: 1) @lisa legal draft within 3 business hours, 2) @mia security checklist and addendum language, 3) @aj + ops finalize runbook and throttle implementation, 4) @nate provide exec ack once docs are in. I'll collect AxonFin signoff on the addendum.

mia (Security): Adding: we will enable pattern-based masking for detected SSNs/emails and retain only hashed request IDs in logs. Will attach checklist.

lisa (Legal): Drafting now. Need Ledger contact for indemnity clause and confirmation they will redact agreed PII fields.

devon (Sales Eng): I'll book a 30-min engineering sync with AxonFin for tomorrow morning to walk the runbook and collect acceptance language.

cora (AE): Thanks team 44d. Posting updates to CRM and will upload legal draft here when done. If any red flags surface, we stop immediately.

nate (CRO): Approved provisionally. If incidents or unredacted PII show up, shut the pilot down and escalate.

(END)
